raw_response:
I am thinking like this: my land is only 12 mu, so I cannot take big risks. I have farmed many years, and I mainly trust what I have seen on my own fields and what other people in the village do. Wheat and maize are the main way to keep income steady here, so I will keep the wheat-maize rotation on most of the land. Cotton takes more watching and more hand work, but if I keep a little of it, then I am not depending on only one crop. I do not read fertilizer formulas, I go by what worked before. If the crop looks weak, I add a bit more. If money is tight, I would rather cut some hired labor first than cut fertilizer too hard, because if yield falls, that hurts more. Water from the well costs money, so I will irrigate at the important times, not too many times.
